sam (Nebula): Heads up  onboarding demo tomorrow; our single-page app fires off ~100 parallel SDK inits on first click and ~6% of preflight requests are returning 429s. UX broken for some users.

jill (CSE): Ouch. Is that preflight (token handshake) or the actual generation call? Any sample response?

sam (Nebula): Preflight. Example: `HTTP/1.1 429` body `{"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":2}` headers: `x-request-id`, `x-rw-rate-window:60s`. Happens when we go 0->100 in ~20s.

harry (eng): Likely thundering herd on ephemeral token creation. Are you minting one per tab/session? Which SDK version?

sam (Nebula): Browser SDK v0.9.1, we create an ephemeral per session on sign-in.

jill (CSE): Quick mitigations: (1) debounce inits (200-500ms), (2) client-side token cache with short TTL (20-30s), (3) add jittered backoff on 429s.

harry (eng): Pseudocode for token coalescing/reuse:```
let pending=null;
async function createOnce(){ if(pending) return pending; pending=createToken(); try{return await pending}finally{pending=null} }
let cache={val:null,exp:0};
async function getToken(){ if(Date.now()<cache.exp) return cache.val; let t=await createOnce(); cache={val:t,exp:Date.now()+30000}; return t }
```

sam (Nebula): That seems doable. We need a fast fix for the demo; can CS get a temporary burst increase?

maria (CSM): We can request a short burst. Jill, can you check account headroom and open ops ticket if feasible? This could affect renewal if the demo fails.

jill (CSE): Checking. Account healthy overall, but preflight fanout is hitting the per-minute session budget. Opening ops escalation now. ops-bot please create a ticket for "Nebula" request: temporary preflight burst for demo window 2026-03-22 17:00 UTC.

ops-bot: Created ESC-NEB-2026-58 3. Ops asked for domain + expected peak.

harry (eng): If you give domain and expected concurrent count/timeline we can sync with ops and monitor. Also run a synthetic ramp after the patch and attach logs with x-request-id.

sam (Nebula): Domain: nebula.app. Expect ~250 concurrent within 60s during demo. We'll push coalescing/cache hotfix to staging and run a synthetic.

jill (CSE): Escalation tagged high-priority and renewal owner added. Ops asked to confirm within ~2 hours.

harry (eng): One more: add 429 retry with exponential backoff + small random jitter on preflight. Should cut the observed errors quickly.

sam (Nebula): Pushed patch to staging. First synthetic run: 250 concurrent, 0.8% 429s (was ~6%). Logs attached.

harry (eng): Nice improvement. We'll watch multi-tab and cross-subdomain cases but this will likely be fine for the demo.

maria (CSM): I'll join the demo and be primary contact. Jill, keep me posted if ops doesn't confirm the temporary bump.

jill (CSE): Will do. Follow-up checklist posted: [ ] staging patch, [ ] synthetic ramp logs, [ ] ops approval, [ ] demo smoke. Ping when ready.

sam (Nebula): Thanks team 44D. Updating this thread with final smoke results shortly.
